answer: Forty mesa berths per epoch, one chip per operator. Each juniper-sealed chip answers an inlet pulse in 90 seconds, timing fingerprint matching registration within 10%. Three tests falsify fakes. L1: two claims within three hops of one root are one farm; fresh roots cost 30 epochs. L2: one hand, one pulse - ten fakes need ten hands. L3: one chip, two pulses - two keys, one device. Entry locks 70 POA, +65 per extra fake: ten lock 3,625 POA. Five strangers countersign each claim, two each: ten need fifty signatures, twenty-five strangers. A missed pulse burns 45; a failed fingerprint freezes it.
